verdict.summary: Boundarying remains a structurally rich specification and evidence-discipline repository, but RC confidence is constrained by three confirmed baseline defects: the substantive implementation is entirely untracked beyond the initial commit, the canonical boundary policy directly conflicts with AGENTS.md over src/Domain, and both validator entrypoints contain a leading stray backslash, with the PowerShell form capable of undermining trustworthy failure semantics. No repository mutation was performed under READ_ONLY authority.
strengths: Clear separation of common/global/domain boundary specifications, consumer/canonization copies, schemas, and evidence mapping.
Explicit machine-readable boundary and evidence-map schemas are present.
The evidence contract defines concrete expected compliance artifacts for shared-database, cross-domain import, foreign-database access, contract-presence, and event-naming checks.
Console MCP resolved the requested Boundarying workspace successfully and deterministic repository inspection was possible.
Boundary domain inventory is explicit and covers the current SmartResponsor component set.
risks: All substantive Boundarying implementation files remain untracked, so commit 03d6277 does not reproduce the assessed working tree.
AGENTS.md forbids src/Domain and src/DomainInterface while boundary-common.yaml explicitly permits both roots.
The conflicting boundary-common policy is duplicated under canonization/common, increasing canon-drift blast radius.
tool/validate-boundary.ps1 starts with a stray backslash before Param, invalidating a clean PowerShell parameter-block entry.
tool/validate-boundary.sh also starts with a stray backslash before the shebang, so its interpreter declaration is not the first line.
No actions/checkout or runs-on declaration was found across the current repository text, so executable GitHub Actions validation remains unsubstantiated.
Expected report/evidence outputs are documented, but no boundary-summary evidence artifact was found by deterministic repository search.
There is no Composer, npm, PHPUnit, PHPStan, or Symfony application manifest evidenced for this repository, so those conventional gates are not applicable from the current repository facts.
next_actions: Reconcile boundary-common.yaml and canonization/common/boundary-common.yaml with the current Symfony-oriented AGENTS.md canon, removing src/Domain and other obsolete layer roots where appropriate.
Repair both validator entrypoints so PowerShell begins with Param and the shell validator begins with its shebang.
Add deterministic positive and negative validator fixtures and require non-zero failure semantics without false-green output.
Establish an executable CI workflow that invokes the canonical validators and records deterministic results.
Generate the evidence artifacts declared by boundary-evidence-map.yaml and bind them to the assessed contract snapshot with hashes.
Commit an intentional reproducible baseline before reassessing RC maturity.
notes: Execution authority was READ_ONLY; no files, Git state, journal, staging, commits, runtime, or repository contents were modified.

Behavioral browser/mobile verification and cohort testing are not evidenced as applicable to this repository snapshot.
